title: Бунт запертого Шефа  (The Locked-Up Chef's Rampage)

segments.t: Trapped inside the cold storage room, Chef Barinov roars that he has an urgent date to get to and threatens to destroy Senya and Fedya the second he gets out. Hearing his furious shouting, the cooks are more convinced than ever that the fugu poison has made him delirious.
Лучше будет, если вы будете сзади!
Иначе я выйду и убью вас!
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.

'Believe me, it will be better this way!' By believing him it will be better this way, Barinov raises the stakes in the room at once. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Лучше будет, если вы будете сзади!

'It will be better if you stay in the back!' Once it will be better if Barinov stays in the back, Senya makes sure Barinov hears every word. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Иначе я выйду и убью вас!
'Otherwise I will come out and kill all of you!' Declaring that otherwise he will come out and kill all of Senya brings Barinov's temper right to the surface.

'Chef, you are not in your right mind!' Senya insists that Barinov is not in Barinov's right mind, leaving Barinov no room to argue. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.

'I am completely in my right mind!' Because he is completely in his right mind, Barinov does not bother softening the blow for Senya. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'I need to go on a date!' Because he needs to go on a date, Senya does not bother softening the blow for Barinov.
'Torture, Chef!' Around the date and shift, Barinov makes his point loud and clear. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'I will show you torture!' Insisting that he will show Barinov torture shows Senya is not backing down. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'I am going to kill Senya, damn it!' Because he is going to kill Senya damn it, Barinov does not bother softening the blow for Senya.
'I want to kill Senya!' Because he wants to kill Senya, Senya does not bother softening the blow for Barinov. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'What? Huh?' Around the room and date, Barinov wants to know where Senya really stands. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Huh? What?' With the room and shift hanging in the air, Senya puts Barinov on the spot.

'Huh? You scoundrels?' Over the room and the conversation, Barinov presses Senya for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Лучше будет, если вы будете сзади!
Иначе я выйду и убью вас!

That wraps up this scene as furious at missing his date with Elena, Chef Barinov pounds on the door and threatens to kill Senya and Fedya while the cooks remain convinced he is delirious. Until next time!
